name: Omnivio Lens
description: Omnivio Lens is a commerce intelligence layer for D2C brands. Connect Claude to your Omnivio account and ask questions about your business in plain English related to sales, returns, P&L, settlement reconciliation, inventory health, warehouse management, ads performance, and much more across Marketplaces like Amazon, Flipkart, quick commerce channels like Blinkit, Zepto & your own Shopify website — no SQL required. Learn more at omnivio.io.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Omnivio Lens to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Omnivio Lens to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai.omnivio.io/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Omnivio Lens MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Omnivio Lens lists 19 MCP tools, including cxo_dashboard_spec, dry_run, get_available_functions, get_available_tables, get_column_info, get_current_data_source_type, get_engine_guide, get_integrations, get_quota_status, get_relationships, get_table_columns_info, and get_table_info.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Omnivio Lens?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Omnivio Lens in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Omnivio Lens MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Omnivio Lens requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Omnivio Lens is developed by Omnivio. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
